Package frc.robot.can

Class AM_CAN_Color_Sensor.AM_ColorSensorData

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.can.AM_CAN_Color_Sensor.AM_ColorSensorData
Enclosing class:
AM_CAN_Color_Sensor
public static class AM_CAN_Color_Sensor.AM_ColorSensorData extends Object
Aggregated readings from the color sensor.

Includes 16-bit clear/red/green/blue values, an 8-bit proximity reading, and a millisecond timestamp.
